title: Compiler Optimization for Sparse Tensor Operations on Specialized Hardware
problem: Generating efficient compiled code for sparse tensor operations on specialized hardware while minimizing compilation time. Existing compiler approaches either incur significant compilation overhead or produce suboptimal code that fails to exploit sparsity patterns.
motivation: Sparse tensor operations are critical in high-impact workloads like graph neural networks and recommendation systems, which require both rapid compilation and near-peak hardware performance for practical deployment.
method: The framework automatically generates hardware-specific code for sparse tensor operations using pattern-based optimization and dataflow analysis. It applies kernel fusion, sparsity-aware scheduling, and specialized code generation to reduce compilation overhead while maintaining near-optimal execution performance across target hardware.
key_novelty: Achieving 60% compilation time reduction while maintaining near-optimal performance through automatic hardware-aware optimization of sparse tensor operations.
contributions: Compiler framework for automatic sparse tensor code generation on specialized hardware
60% reduction in compilation time versus existing approaches
Near-optimal performance on GNNs and recommendation systems
Sparsity-aware optimization strategies that scale across hardware targets
